home_body: Help build a reliable corpus, then automatically generate sentence lists.
home_classify_description: Indicate whether the proposed sentences are correct, plausible, and appropriate to help improve the generator.
home_generate_description: Create sentence lists in just a few clicks.
home_api_description: Integrate lexical generation into your scripts and applications.
api_intro: Generate lists of accepted French sentences. Calls require an individual API key; this documentation is open to everyone.
api_access_body: Keys are issued manually. Describe your project and intended use to request a key.
api_access_cta: Email the Genlexis team to obtain your API key
api_quickstart_body: Send your key in the Authorization header.
api_response_body: The response reports applied options, the seed, lists, requested and returned item counts, and complete. phoneme_balanced also adds scores, aggregateScore, and poolSize.
api_modes_body: random samples accepted sentences; phoneme_balanced aims to match each list to the French phoneme distribution and reports scores. language fr-FR is required for both modes.
api_filters_body: Optional filters: detType (definite, indefinite), gender (m, f), grammNumber (s, p), length (1 to 20) with lengthUnit (syllables, phonemes), and lexicalDensity (high, medium, low). Patterns: noun, det_noun, det_noun_adj, np_verb. Up to 5 lists of 50 items.
api_partial_body: An incomplete request returns 422. Set allowPartial: true to receive available items; an empty result is still an error. The same seed and parameters reproduce a result while the corpus and generation rules remain unchanged.
api_errors_body: 400: invalid request; 401: missing or invalid key; 403: insufficient permission; 422: insufficient material or unavailable corpus; 503: unavailable service. Responses contain error.code and error.message.
api_generation_endpoint_description: A seed reproduces the result only while the corpus and generation rules remain unchanged. No generation result is stored. The request is refused if it cannot be filled, unless allowPartial is true. An empty result is always refused.
api_generation_auth_description: An API key is required. It is issued by the Genlexis team.
api_generation_success_description: Complete generation or an explicitly permitted partial result.
api_generation_error_description: A stable error code with an explanatory message.
api_scores_description: Per-list phoneme distance; present only with phoneme_balanced.
home_support_body: Genlexis is free and open-source. Your support helps cover hosting costs and fund new features.
classify_instruction: Mark the sentence correct only if it is syntactically valid, semantically plausible, and non-offensive.
classify_instruction_binary: Mark the sentence correct only if it is syntactically valid, semantically plausible, and non-offensive.
classify_instruction_cascade: Check in turn whether the sentence is appropriate, grammatically correct, and then semantically sound.
classify_empty_body: Every candidate sentence is currently accepted, rejected, or waiting for new generated input.
generate_instruction: Configure your filters and generate up to {maxLists} parallel lists with no overlap between them.
generate_disabled_body: Generation will be available once at least one accepted sentence exists.
generate_partial_notice: Only {actual} of the {requested} requested items matched your filters.
generate_empty_notice: No sentence available for the selected filters.
generate_balance_help: Pick words so each list approximates the French phoneme distribution.
generate_unbalanced_warning: Some lists deviate notably from the target phoneme distribution. Try increasing the items per list for a closer match.
